scenes.hook: JavaScript Loops. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Loops repeat instructions without writing the same code repeatedly. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: A for loop can initialize a counter, check a condition, and update it. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: Each pass through the loop is called an iteration. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Make sure the condition can become false to avoid an infinite loop. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
